title: Market Shadow Map: inference competitor operations & signal-to-provision runbook
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Objective: produce a runnable 'Market Shadow Map' that links observed competitor operational signals (availability, latency spikes, model variant rollouts, pricing/quantization changes) to recommended Redwood provisioning and fallback actions. Scope: 1) define a taxonomy of observable signals from public telemetry and partner feeds; 2) map signals to probabilistic impact on hosted/dedicated/private customers; 3) author a step-by-step runbook for SRE/On-call and Sales/AE playbooks for customer communication and remediation; 4) deliver a minimal dashboard prototype that surface prioritized signals and suggested actions.
acceptance_criteria: Taxonomy doc covering at least 12 signal types and detection heuristics (link to confluence)
A decision matrix mapping signals to recommended action (fallback to compatible model, region reroute, reserved capacity burst)
Runbook with clear play steps for SRE, PM-TOC, and Sales with templated customer messaging
Dashboard prototype wired to sample telemetry that highlights top-3 active signals and a clickable action card
Three tabletop exercises executed with SRE/Product/Support and documented outcomes
